Orchestrator.summary: Orchestrator adds a new authentication option for Azure Storage buckets, updates side-panel behavior and resizing, and changes the default API specification to OpenAPI 3.0 Public profile while deprecating the previous V20/Swagger 2.0 specification.
Orchestrator.overall_analysis: These changes improve security and user experience, while also moving API consumers toward a newer specification before the older one is removed in September 2026.

changes.name: Integration Service authentication for Azure Storage buckets
changes.summary: Azure Storage buckets can now be authenticated using Integration Service service-principal connections instead of storage-account access keys.
changes.analysis: This likely reduces reliance on storage-account keys and supports a more centralized and potentially more secure authentication approach.
changes.impact: Users and administrators configuring Azure Storage buckets in Orchestrator, especially those managing authentication and security practices.

changes.name: Updated side-panel behavior and resizing
changes.summary: Side panels now render on top of primary content instead of pushing it aside, and they are resizable with a persisted width.
changes.analysis: This likely improves workspace usability by preserving the main page layout and allowing users to keep preferred panel sizes across sessions.
changes.impact: All users interacting with side panels in the Orchestrator interface.

changes.name: Default API specification changed to OpenAPI 3.0 Public profile
changes.summary: The default API specification is now OpenAPI 3.0 Public profile; the previous V20/Swagger 2.0 specification is deprecated and will be removed in September 2026.
changes.analysis: This signals a transition to a newer API standard and gives API consumers advance notice to migrate away from the deprecated specification before its removal.
changes.impact: Developers, integrators, and tools that consume the Orchestrator API specification, particularly any still depending on V20/Swagger 2.0.

Task Mining.summary: Task Mining in Automation Cloud Public Sector is being retired effective September 1, 2026.
Task Mining.overall_analysis: This is a product retirement that redirects investment toward Delegate - Cartographer, indicating a strategic shift away from Task Mining in this environment.

changes.name: Task Mining retirement in Automation Cloud Public Sector
changes.summary: Task Mining in Automation Cloud Public Sector is being retired, effective September 1, 2026, to redirect resources toward Delegate - Cartographer.
changes.analysis: This indicates the product will no longer be supported in this environment, and customers may need to transition plans or workflows in response to the retirement.
changes.impact: Current and prospective Task Mining users in Automation Cloud Public Sector.

Test Manager.summary: Test Manager updates the manual execution assistant layout, makes Excel export of requirements and test cases asynchronous with one column per custom field, and removes the iText PDF library dependency, resulting in text-only PDF attachments in the cloud.
Test Manager.overall_analysis: The release combines usability and export improvements with a breaking change to PDF attachment behavior in the cloud, which may require users to adjust documentation or attachment expectations.

changes.name: Manual execution assistant description placement
changes.summary: The manual execution assistant now shows the test case description above Precondition.
changes.analysis: This likely improves readability and gives testers earlier context when manually executing test cases.
changes.impact: Users performing manual test execution in Test Manager.

changes.name: Asynchronous Excel export with custom-field columns
changes.summary: Excel export of requirements and test cases is now asynchronous with one column per custom field.
changes.analysis: This likely improves export handling for larger jobs and makes exported data more structured and easier to analyze based on custom fields.
changes.impact: Users exporting requirements and test cases to Excel, especially those using custom fields.

changes.name: Removal of iText PDF library dependency
changes.summary: The iText PDF library dependency was removed; as a breaking change, PDF attachments are now text-only in the cloud.
changes.analysis: This changes how PDF attachments are handled in the cloud and may limit attachment fidelity or formatting compared with previous behavior.
changes.impact: Cloud users who attach or rely on PDF content in Test Manager.
